title: The scalar and integral arrows at a finite level
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of the l-adic rationals, a scheme T, Chern data c [def-sp-tower-class-chern], an integral degree-two arrow f from the coefficient single to the root single, and n a natural number, define the evaluated scalar arrow by exact evaluation, the prescribed lineEvaluation, and forgetting coefficients [def-sp-tower-class-finite]; define the integral arrow by evaluation of underlyingChernArrow [def-sfb-tower-underlying-arrow]. These are exactly the two arrows previously defined in ScalarFiniteBoundaryComposition.

source.place: clause (2), scalar extension and finite evaluation

proof.text: Use the original formulas verbatim: forgetEvaluatedArrow applied to scalarChernArrow, and mapSingleArrow of abEvaluation applied to underlyingChernArrow. The extraction shares the compiled endpoint definitions without changing them.
